text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the day of the spring Tenno Sho, the audience is geared up to see Seiun Sky and Special Week go head-to-head.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky is unusually serious. Even when I embarrass her with some supportive words, she remains deep in thought.
